stem: Which sentence from the story shows that Kevin thinks being honest is important?

options.label: A
options.text: Maybe he could pretend he felt sick. (paragraph 14)

options.label: C
options.text: Maybe he could get his baby brother, Jace, to take all of Grandpa’s attention. (paragraph 16)

options.label: D
options.text: When Saturday finally arrived, Kevin still hadn’t figured out what he was going to do. (paragraph 18)
